notes.title: RedDeer.Games presents a new, cozy, puzzle game - Tell Me Your Story 📖
notes.content:
RedDeer.Games announces developement of a new in house game - Tell Me Your Story - proposition for every fan of story-driven, cozy & puzzle games! 


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42267264/9740fd7b2d093f1a8556098e40c9e72dc7fbff67.jpg

Amelia comes to her grandma's cottage for the summer, expecting to spend the warm months there knitting, gardening, and helping her out. Soon enough, the girl realizes that her grandma Rose's house is full of wonders, artifacts, and souvenirs from all around the world. 

And so begins a journey to the past via the tales and memories of a retired globetrotter – a side of Amelia’s grandma, that she had no idea about.



{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42267264/5a0570940adae65b57d63025550b2a9dbeed5c45.jpg

In Tell Me Your Story, the players, together with Amelia, will be tasked with helping the elderly woman with everyday chores – that is until they will find a couple of interesting artifacts. 

This discovery will turn the summer vacation around and Rose's adventurous past will be unearthed in the form of colorful memories.

To follow the story, the players will solve region-themed puzzles, surrounded by the hand-drawn scenery. There will be over 70 different types of riddles, neatly separated into 3 chapters related to Rose’s travels. Visiting South America's rainforests, the Chinese province of Yunnan, and the track of Orient Express' first route – that’s what players can expect.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42267264/3f66393b0ce00aee6bc61123985dcbc72e205ea4.jpg

Tell Me Your Story has eye-catching and cozy visuals, that fit perfectly with the theme of getting to know the past of one's family. Those tales will be powered by Amelia's vivid imagination – which conveys the wordless game’s story perfectly.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42267264/bdafd80507fdf0732489c23bdcd9e671afc91026.gif
Tell Me Your Story will be available on Steam and Nintendo Switch in 2024

You can wishlist the game now! 


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1415570/Tell_me_your_story/?beta=0

notes.title: One Night: Burlesque is out now!
notes.content:
Step now into Angels Den and see the club in its full glory – One Night: Burlesque, the supernatural detective story is now available on Steam!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44592147/c6c3f48ba19221b0ee9689c5901b591a07e25a10.jpg

We've just opened the door... Door of Angels Dan. One Night: Burlesque, the awaited mystery visual novel with a supernatural twist is out now on Steam! 

The game introduces the players to Holly – one of the club's dancers, that is having quite a rough time. She's struggling to keep her hidden, mind-reading abilities under control, and this could ruin more than just this one night at the club. 

Holly’s night changes drastically – from an everyday burlesque show into a murder-mystery race with time. This makes her pull all the stops and decide to find out who's behind this by herself. The players follow her and together interview a list of suspects, make choices, play story-related minigames, and, most importantly, decide when to read thoughts of others!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44592147/a49704ffba374b503ff7ca643ca7e47183c3a2e0.jpg

The world in One Night: Burlesque isn't black and white – the noir red is replaced by pink, and the modern setting is underlined by neon lights. Here, everything depends on the player's choices and multiple endings can be obtained, even without using Holly's mind-reading abilities. 


One Night: Burlesque is available now, both on Steam but also on Nintendo Switch!. The latter has a demo version of the game available to download anytime.

Enjoy the game, friends!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2515310/One_Night_Burlesque/

notes.title: Let the show begin! One Night: Burlesque has a release date!
notes.content:
Read the minds of others and reveal whose thoughts are the source of your murderous visions! One Night: Burlesque will land on Steam and Nintendo Switch on November 3rd 💋

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44592147/30011892220395da6a8ecb321f68f8a2e385a1a8.jpg

One Night: Burlesque is a hand-drawn, detective visual novel, where the modern world is presented with a noir touch. You will find yourself in deep conversations, making choices based on people's words or on what exactly hides behind their eyes. 👁 👁

Follow the steps of Holly, one of Angels Den's most charismatic dancers, and help her discover who might be targeting her friend. 

There's many people in the club at late night hour – each of them looking for something different, each thinking of something different…

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44592147/a3fa321c6d64c49a7a161dde1a6c3034faf6f4b4.jpg

In the world of One Night: Burlesque some people are born with supernatural powers. They keep them at bay using special pills – which the main character, Holly, ran out of tonight. 

With her mind-reading powers at full capacity the initial, bloody thought might not be the only one she hears tonight. Tough there’s a question only you can answer – to read or not to read? 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44592147/127dfe50325c46a0b924878b4a5e92e258134d73.jpg

GAME KEY FEATURES:


♦︎ A noir aesthetic ♦︎
♦︎ A detective-style murder mystery ♦︎
♦︎ A unique setting (a Burlesque Club) ♦︎
♦︎ Multiple endings depending on your choices ♦︎
♦︎ An Incredible music track ♦︎
♦︎ A charming telepathic dancer ♦︎

  🍸 🥃 🍹

One Night: Burlesque will be available on Steam and the Nintendo Switch consoles later on NOVEMBER 3RD, and the game is available on Steam Wishlist now. You can also play the demo with the whole Act I!

[previewyoutube=eLOpRSSzHeQ;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Play the demo of One Night: Burlesque now!
notes.content:
One Night: Burlesque is a hand-drawn, detective visual novel, where the modern world is presented with a noir touch. The demo containing the first act of the game is available now on Steam!

One Night: Burlesque is a noir visual novel that takes place in a luxurious club Angels Den. The players will step into the shoes of Holly – a charismatic dancer with unique mind-reading powers. 

Those abilities come in the clutch when she hears a stray thought that will turn her night upside down and push her to uncover the planned murder of her best friend.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44592147/30011892220395da6a8ecb321f68f8a2e385a1a8.jpg

In the world of One Night: Burlesque, some people can be extraordinary — their powers can be regarded as a blessing or a curse depending on the perspective. As for Holly...

– Holly's 'vision' comes to her, because she is running out of meds that keep her 'illness' in check. That's why at the beginning she has no idea whose emotions/thoughts she just read –  Says Basia Leśniewska, 2D Artist, RedDeer.Games.

...the players will decide that for themselves.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44592147/c6c3f48ba19221b0ee9689c5901b591a07e25a10.jpg

As players accompany Holly there will be mysteries to uncover, choices to be made, and three endings to obtain. All of this is for players to discover – whether with or without the supernatural aspect of the game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44592147/a49704ffba374b503ff7ca643ca7e47183c3a2e0.jpg

The playable demo version of the game that covers the entirety of act I is available now on Steam!

If you want to be up-to-date with RedDeer.Games projects, visit the official website, Facebook and Twitter.
